token = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJwaG9uZSs4NTA2MDUxNTYzIiwiZXhwIjoxNjg0NDEyMDk4fQ.QvARzdbSokHwI73CiRsdnvbE23nJAIJNWrM_4C6rRiU'
all_contacts=[]
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=token, query='', page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_contacts.extend(page)
    i+=1
print('pages', i, 'total_contacts', len(all_contacts))
# find contacts marked as parent/mother/father
parent_contacts=[c for c in all_contacts if any(rel in ['parent','mother','father'] for rel in (c.get('relationships') or []))]
print('parent_contacts', len(parent_contacts))
print([(c['first_name'], c['last_name'], c.get('email'), c.get('phone_number'), c.get('home_address').splitlines()[0]) for c in parent_contacts])
# unique home addresses for parents
addrs=set([c.get('home_address','') for c in parent_contacts])
print('unique_parent_home_addresses', len(addrs))
for a in list(addrs)[:5]:
    print('---')
    print(a)
